title: Exact Color Kinematics Duality in the Cosmological Correlators
summary: In this paper, we study color kinematics duality and related double-copy and BCJ structures in the cosmological Grassmannian framework. The simplicity of these correlators in this framework makes it possible to test the double copy construction beyond flat space. We show that the four-point gluon correlator admits a representation whose kinematic numerators satisfy an algebraically exact Jacobi identity, $n_s$ + $n_t$ + $n_u$ = 0.
